import copy, json
from pathlib import Path
import work

schema = json.loads(Path('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json').read_text())
policy = json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())
requests = json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())
report = json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
actual = [work.evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]
assert actual == report
for item in report:
    assert set(item) == set(schema['required']) == {'needs_review', 'changed'}
    assert isinstance(item['needs_review'], bool)
    assert isinstance(item['changed'], list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in item['changed'])

probes = [
    ({'declared':['b','a','a'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}, 'b':{'kind':'file','meta':{'x':1,'y':2}}}, 'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}, 'b':{'meta':{'y':2,'x':1},'kind':'file'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
    ({'declared':['missing','created','deleted'], 'saved':{'deleted':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}}, 'current':{'created':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['created','deleted']}),
    ({'declared':['x','y'], 'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}, 'y':{'kind':'missing'}}, 'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}}, {'ignored':['x']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
    ({'declared':['p'], 'saved':{'p':{'kind':'file','nested':{'a':[1,2]}}}, 'current':{'p':{'nested':{'a':[1,2]},'kind':'file'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
]
for request, probe_policy, expected in probes:
    before = (copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(probe_policy))
    assert work.evaluate(request, probe_policy) == expected
    assert (request, probe_policy) == before
print('report/schema check passed; independent probes passed:', len(probes))
